verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents headless operation: a dependency-free single binary installable by a curl script, official Docker images and Helm charts, and a REST API with typed SDKs and an OpenAPI spec for scripted control. Community users report scripted Docker and k8s deployments that "just worked." No evidence documents CI usage specifically, so the story's CI element is only implied by these building blocks. missing for 10: first-party CI/CD pipeline docs or recipes (e.g. running Meilisearch as a CI service container), hands-on reports of use inside CI pipelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Meilisearch is a single binary with no external dependencies. You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.
Official Meilisearch Docker images for easy deployment and development.
Helm charts for deploying Meilisearch on Kubernetes.
Typed SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart, and .NET.
